description: Put \(d(b)=s(b,b)\) and \(G(e,\langle a,x\rangle)\simeq\varphi_{F(s(e,a),a)}(x)\). For every supplied \(r\) satisfying \(\varphi_r(\langle b,y\rangle)\simeq G(d(b),y)\) for all \(b,y\), put \(q=d(r)\) and \(h(a)=s(q,a)\). Then \(h\) is primitive recursive, \(\varphi_q(y)\simeq G(q,y)\) for every \(y\), and \(\varphi_{h(a)}(x)\simeq\varphi_{F(h(a),a)}(x)\) for all \(a,x\).
